title: Happy robot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='50' y1='12' x2='50' y2='24' stroke='#8fd8ff' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='6' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='3' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x='26' y='24' width='48' height='36' rx='10' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <rect x='30' y='28' width='40' height='28' rx='7' fill='#1d2b52'/>

  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='5' fill='#7dffb0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='5' fill='#7dffb0'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='38.5' r='2' fill='#eafff4'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='38.5' r='2' fill='#eafff4'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 48 Q50 55 60 48' stroke='#7dffb0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <rect x='18' y='36' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#ffa94d'/>

  <rect x='30' y='66' width='40' height='26' rx='8' fill='#7fd4ff'/>

  <circle cx='45' cy='78' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='78' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <rect x='20' y='68' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#ffa94d'/>
  <rect x='72' y='68' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#ffa94d'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='34' y='90' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#8fd8ff'/>
  <rect x='54' y='90' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#8fd8ff'/>
</svg>
